idea: Build CrownCut, a luxury barber salon booking app with haircut & beard service menu, master stylist selection, appointment time slot picker, and booking receipt confirmation
targetMarket: High-end consumers seeking premium grooming services (precision haircuts, bespoke beard treatments, executive spa packages) and luxury barbershops or boutique grooming lounges requiring white-glove digital touchpoints, brand exclusivity, and specialized VIP client management.

competitors.name: Booksy
competitors.overview: Leading appointment booking platform tailored for barbershops and beauty professionals with a broad marketplace reach.
competitors.pricing: Subscription fee (~$29.99/mo) plus upfront cuts/commissions on first-time client bookings.
competitors.complaints: High commissions on marketplace-driven clients, generic user interface that lacks a luxury aesthetic, and client data lock-in.

competitors.name: GlossGenius
competitors.overview: Aesthetically focused booking and business management platform popular among independent stylists and beauty pros.
competitors.pricing: Flat monthly subscription tiers starting at $24/mo to $48/mo + standard card processing fees.
competitors.complaints: Limited custom VIP concierge workflows, standardized templates that lack high-end exclusivity, and lack of specialized grooming add-ons.

competitors.name: Fresha
competitors.overview: Global salon software providing appointment management, POS, and integrated marketplace features.
competitors.pricing: Free core software with mandatory payment processing fees and a 20% fee on new marketplace client bookings.
competitors.complaints: Unpredictable transaction fees for marketplace bookings and a commoditized client experience that treats luxury salons like standard walk-in shops.

competitorFeatures: Digital service catalogs and price menus
